set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM first-level numerical/resource qualification and public documentation; Gale owns reusable kernel/backend improvements. Depends on the native output-selective request and executor, bd-01M1ZAJZERT9MWBE95TGBSWM88. Consumer demand is recorded in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/docs/first-level-estimation-contract.md.

Acceptance:
- Benchmark representative condition-beta, few-contrast and dense FIR requests with realistic scans, nuisance counts, voxel counts and run structure. Include cold and warm data access, selected versus full outputs, OLS and each actually admitted noise/pooling path. State reference hardware, JDK/platform, backend, native threads and exact revisions.
- Separate compile, verification/decompression, payload read, conversion/packing, kernel, required uncertainty/noise estimation, pooling, output writing, peak resident/heap/native memory and cancellation. Compare complete equivalent scientific requests against the current full-fit baseline. No FLOP estimates, kernel-only measurements or tiny fixtures advertised as whole-brain speedups.
- Independently verify equivalence before measuring. Prove bounded reads/allocation and no hidden full fit from the ordinary public pipeline. Test heap/native and skinny-output shapes, block sizes, layouts and thread oversubscription. Route general improvements upstream into Gale and verify required platforms/direct consumers before adoption.
- Evaluate reusable fixed temporal adjoints, exact run blocks and independent output bases when useful. Precision reduction, approximate whitening groups, FFT/sparse assumptions and GPU paths require explicit evidence/admission; none is a prerequisite for a fast exact double-precision CPU release or a reason to change the estimand.
- Provide concise executable examples for selected condition betas, FIR coefficients, named contrasts, optional uncertainty, optional nuisance retention, plan inspection and bounded execution. Verify examples and relevant shared tests on JVM and Scala.js, plus native backend gates on supported platforms. Document limitations and capability/fallback receipts honestly.
- Retain machine-readable benchmark receipts and identify any remaining bottleneck as a bounded native follow-up. Consumer dependency adoption remains a separate PLS Neuro integration gate.
set.title: Qualify selected-estimate throughput and publish executable first-level examples
